summary.en: The words beside a real asset: a value, a line and a mono note stacked in the margin, each rising through its own rail and leaving up through it.
summary.zh: 真实素材旁边的字：一个数值、一行说明和一行等宽注释叠在页边，各自从自己的轨道升起、再向上退出。

fits: Copy that must be read next to evidence it does not cover: a device, a print, a frame.
notFor: Text laid over the asset; long paragraphs.

intent.en: Everything the viewer must read is set in code beside the evidence, never inside it.
intent.zh: 观众要读的字都在证据旁边用代码排出，从不压在证据上。

content.en: A value (≤ 10 chars / 5 字), a line (≤ 18 chars / 14 字), a note (≤ 40 chars / 22 字) or an address.
content.zh: 一个数值（≤ 10 字符 / 5 字）、一行说明（≤ 18 字符 / 14 字）、一条注释（≤ 40 字符 / 22 字）或一个网址。

fits.zh: 必须挨着证据读、又不能盖住证据的文字：设备、印件、画格旁。

notFor.zh: 压在素材上的字；长段落。

en: Keep the value one size for the scene (95 or 76 px); do not shrink line by line.
zh: 同一场的数值只用一个字号（95 或 76 像素），不要逐行缩字。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
